Legacy code powers some of the world's most important systems, but maintaining it is becoming increasingly difficult. Anna Gutowska explains what legacy code is, why modernization is so challenging, and how AI can accelerate software migration, documentation, testing, and modernization workflows. Learn how AI helps teams preserve critical business logic while reducing technical debt and modernization risk.
